title: Front Desk Guidance — Copays and Estimate Collections at Check-In, Patient Financial Account
content:
At check-in, what is collected toward a visit on a Patient Financial Account follows the account's financial class and the visit's copay class under the appointment rules.

## Copay

When the tier collects the copay at check-in, the copay recorded on the account is collected for the encounter according to the copay class of the visit type:

| Copay class of the visit type | Copay collected |
|---|---|
| primary | the primary care copay recorded on the account |
| specialist | the specialist copay recorded on the account |
| none | nothing |

## Share of the estimate

When the tier's share of the estimate collected at the time of service is above 0.00, the group also collects that share of the encounter's estimate amount, capped at the tier's time-of-service estimate cap and, for insured tiers, never more than the remaining deductible recorded on the account. The collection is the estimate multiplied by the share percentage and rounded to the nearest cent, or the cap if that is lower. For the Self-Pay Account, a booking deposit already applied to the encounter under the appointment rules counts toward that cap.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** An insured tier collecting 50.00 percent up to 250.00, with an encounter estimate of 640.00 and a recorded remaining deductible of 280.00: 50.00 percent of 640.00 is 320.00; the cap brings it to 250.00; 250.00 does not exceed the remaining deductible of 280.00, so 250.00 is collected. Had the remaining deductible been 180.00, the collection would be 180.00.

## Classes that collect nothing

A tier whose copay is not collected at check-in and whose estimate share is 0.00 collects nothing at check-in. Medicaid Managed Care patients are never asked for payment at the time of service.

## Waiving a copay

A copay may be waived only case by case, only where the tier permits a hardship copay waiver, and only where the account carries an unexpired hardship approval — its hardship-approved-through date on or after the date of service. A routine or courtesy waiver is never granted.

| Tier permits hardship waiver | Hardship approval through a date on or after the date of service | Copay may be waived case by case |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |
| yes | no | no |
| no | yes | no |
| no | no | no |

## Recording

A collection is recorded against the copay or estimate charge of the same encounter.
